cmd: python -c 'import os,io,sys,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,contextlib; sys.path.insert(0,"tools/cc"); import ship; R=os.getcwd(); e={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}; e.update(GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@t",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@t"); t=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(ignore_cleanup_errors=True); d=t.name; g=lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git",*a],cwd=d,env=e,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout; w=lambda m: (pathlib.Path(d,m).write_text(m), g("add",m), g("commit","-q","-m",m)); g("init","-q","-b","main"); w("a"); g("switch","-q","-c","lane/x"); w("b"); g("switch","-q","main"); w("c"); g("switch","-q","lane/x"); g("merge","-q","--no-edit","main"); [setattr(ship,k,v) for k,v in dict(default_branch=lambda: "main", pr_for_branch=lambda *a,**k: None, _remote_has_commits_we_lack=lambda *a,**k: 0, handoff_push_setting=lambda r: (False,""), _merge_base_first=lambda *a,**k: None, marker_needed=lambda *a,**k: [], _refuse_a_marked_record=lambda r: None).items()]; b=io.StringIO(); os.chdir(d); cm=contextlib.redirect_stdout(b); cm.__enter__(); ship.open_pr(dry_run=True); cm.__exit__(None,None,None); os.chdir(R); print(any("gh pr create" in l and "Merge branch" in l for l in b.getvalue().splitlines()))'
